outcome: Maternal and neonatal outcomes of COVID-19 vaccination
Maternal complications (anemia, preterm labor, gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, hypothyroidism, prolonged labor, postpartum hemorrhage)
Neonatal outcomes (birth weight, APGAR score, meconium aspiration syndrome, respiratory distress syndrome, NICU admission)
cohort: 3320 pregnant women who delivered at a hospital in Fatehpur, India, between November 2021 and October 2022, of whom 1170 (35.24%) received at least one dose of the COVID-19 vaccine.
finding: COVID-19 vaccination during pregnancy was not associated with an increased risk of adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: 56.15% of vaccinated women delivered vaginally, 37.69% had a lower segment cesarean section (LSCS), and 6.15% had an instrumental delivery.
birth_weight: 50.77% of newborns weighed between 2.5 and 2.9 kg.
